settings.title: AI assistant
settings.intro: Optional: an AI model helps you edit the DXF/IFC plans of a project. Off by default.
settings.ollama_hint: With local models no data leaves this computer or your own network.
settings.api_key_hint: Leave empty to keep the stored key.
settings.cost_day: Cost limit per project and day (USD)
settings.cost_hint: 0 = no limit. Without a known price, requests are blocked while a limit is set.
settings.models_no_tools: None of the {count} models can call tools. Please install a model with tool support.

model_warning.no_tools: This model cannot call tools and is not suitable for the assistant.
model_warning.tools_unknown: It is unknown whether this model can call tools.
model_warning.small_context: The context window of this model is smaller than 16k tokens; longer conversations and large plans do not fit.
model_warning.remote: Ollama cloud model: the data leaves this computer.

settings.num_ctx_hint: A larger context window allows more chat history and elements per question but needs more graphics memory. Recommended: Automatic.
settings.text_only_forced: This model cannot read images; text only stays on.
settings.saved_inactive: Saved. The assistant is not active yet (switch on, provider configured and model chosen).

privacy.title: Data sent to the cloud provider
privacy.body: Sent are the element list, the selection and measured values; images only when 'text only' is off. Photos and panoramas are never sent.

error.no_key: No API key stored for this provider.
error.model_missing: The model does not exist on the server ({detail}).
error.no_tools: The model does not support tool calls ({detail}).
error.rate_limited_retry: Too many requests, try again in {seconds} s ({detail}).
error.context: The model's context is full or the model keeps repeating itself (HTTP {code}: {detail}).
error.bad_json: The server answer could not be read.

cost.unknown_price: No price known for model {model}. Enter it under prices_usd_per_mtok in config/ai_assistant.yaml or set the cost limits to 0.
cost.request_limit: This request would cost about {cost} USD, above the limit of {limit} USD per request.
cost.day_limit: Today's spend in this project ({spent} USD) plus this request ({cost} USD) exceeds the daily limit of {limit} USD.
cost.price: Price: {input} USD input / {output} USD output per million tokens

settings.full_control_hint: With full control the AI may change all results of this project (every element type, many elements at once, new walls, room outlines). Changes are applied directly after a passed quality check, without an accept click; every change is listed in the history and can be undone. Never code, settings or other projects.
settings.full_control_explicit: Your own choice is saved and applies to every provider.

edit.not_found: There is no element {id} in the plan.
edit.invalid_value: {name} {value} is outside the allowed range {min} to {max}.
edit.opening_outside_wall: Opening {id} would reach {overhang_m} m beyond the ends of wall {wall}.
edit.no_evidence: The point cloud shows no {kind} there ({reason}).
edit.cloud_required: Adding {kind} needs the project point cloud as evidence.
edit.wall_too_short: The change would make wall {id} too short.
edit.geometry: The geometry of {id} does not allow this change.
edit.manual_not_allowed: Without evidence in the point cloud an object is only placed after you confirm it.
edit.blocks_opening: The new wall {id} would block opening {opening}.
edit.split_failed: The line does not split room {id} into two parts.
edit.not_adjacent: Rooms {id} and {other} do not touch (delete the wall between them first).
edit.no_match: No element of type {kind} matches the filter.

history.outdated: The plan changed since the proposal was made. Please ask again.
history.locked: Another change is being saved right now. Please try again in a moment.
history.no_base: The original plan of this level is missing; the change cannot be undone.
history.no_plan: This level has no plan model yet.
history.version: The change history of this project has an unknown version.
history.element_gone: Element {id} of this change no longer exists in the recomputed plan.
history.ambiguous: This change no longer matches the recomputed plan unambiguously.

agent.disabled: The AI assistant is switched off (Settings).
agent.not_configured: The AI assistant is not configured yet (Settings: provider and key or server address).
agent.no_model: No model chosen for the AI assistant (Settings).
agent.no_plan: This level has no plan model yet. Create the DXF/IFC first.
agent.outdoor_pending: AI assistant for outdoor projects is being prepared. It is not available for this drone / environment project yet.
agent.needs_environment: For outdoor projects the AI assistant works with the environment chain (drone project). This project has none.
agent.outdoor_no_scene: This drone project has no site model yet. Run the environment computation first.
agent.no_tools: The model {model} cannot call tools. Choose a model with tool support.
agent.empty_prompt: Please describe what should be changed.
agent.busy: The assistant is still working on the previous request.
agent.too_many_tools: Stopped after {count} tool calls without a finished proposal. Nothing was changed; please ask more precisely.
agent.qa_failed:
The proposal was discarded because the quality check still found problems:
{findings}
agent.unexpected: The assistant stopped unexpectedly ({detail}). The plan was not changed.
agent.cloud_unavailable: The project point cloud is not available; nothing could be measured.
agent.bad_arguments: The model called {tool} with invalid values.
agent.unknown_tool: The model called an unknown tool ({tool}).
agent.confirm_required: This proposal deletes elements or changes more than 5 elements. Please confirm it.
agent.no_pending: There is no proposal to accept.
agent.retried_fresh: The question was asked again in a new chat context.
agent.context_failed: The request does not fit the model's context, not even in a new chat context. {detail} Tip: choose a larger model or a larger context (Settings, AI assistant).
agent.context_full: Estimated {tokens} tokens, the context window has {window} tokens.
agent.empty_answer: The model answered empty or cut off.

panel.title: AI assistant
panel.selection_empty: Nothing selected. Click an element in the 2D plan or the 3D model; Ctrl+click adds more.
panel.unknown_selection: This element is not part of the plan and cannot be selected.
panel.unknown_selection_outdoor: This element is not part of the outdoor model and cannot be selected.
panel.selection_empty_outdoor: Nothing selected. Click an element in the DXF preview or the 3D model; Ctrl+click adds more, a click into empty space picks a point.
panel.outdoor_scope: Outdoor project: trees, manholes, fences, garden walls and curbs; coordinates LV95 (E/N).
panel.input_placeholder: e.g. make this door 90 cm wide
panel.chat_empty: No messages yet. Select elements and describe the change.
panel.chat_cleared: Chat cleared. Accepted changes are kept.
panel.accepted: Change {id} accepted. DXF and IFC are exported again.
panel.accepted_dxf: Change {id} accepted. The DXF is exported again.
panel.rebased: The proposal was applied to the recomputed plan ({mapping}).
panel.ask_again: The proposal was discarded. Please ask again.
panel.locked_hint: An export is running or a change is being saved. Accept and undo are possible afterwards.
panel.manual_question: The point cloud shows nothing there. Place the object manually anyway?
panel.undo_confirm_body: The change touched {count} elements; deleted elements come back.
panel.undone: Change {id} undone. The exports run again.
panel.pipeline_error: Step {step}: the changes could not be re-applied ({error}).
panel.export_done: The exports are up to date.
panel.export_failed: The export {action} did not finish. See the job log in the compute card.
panel.export_start_failed: The export could not be started: {error}
panel.update_all: No usable computation for this storey yet – computing everything … {percent} %
panel.update_done: Done – DXF and IFC show the change.
panel.update_done_dxf: Done – the DXF shows the change.
panel.update_plan_stale: The change was drawn into the existing plan. The plan itself no longer matches the current program version or settings – "Compute everything" recomputes it, the changes are kept.
panel.unexpected: The request failed unexpectedly ({detail}). Nothing was changed.
panel.variant_hint: The AI assistant works on the ortho plan – switch the view to ortho.
panel.pick_failed: The clicked position could not be evaluated.
panel.no_proposal: No change proposed – the plan was not changed.
panel.no_proposal_claim: The AI did not carry out any change. Please ask again or select the element more precisely.
panel.full_mode: Full control: changes are applied directly after a passed check.
panel.applied_notify: Change {id} applied. DXF and IFC are being updated.
panel.applied_notify_dxf: Change {id} applied. The DXF is being updated.

rules.evidence: No evidence = nothing: trees and manholes are only added with matching points in the point cloud.
rules.measured: Dimensions are measured in the point cloud, never estimated.
rules.coordinates: Coordinates in LV95 (east/north), heights in LN02, all in metres.
rules.terrain: Tree bases, fence and wall bottoms stay flush with the terrain; curbs and gutters are recomputed by SAMcloud.

outdoor.duplicate: There is already an element here ({id}).
outdoor.no_terrain: There is no terrain at this position.
outdoor.no_road_side: The road side of curb {id} is unknown; a gutter is not possible.
outdoor.export_running: DXF and IFC are being updated (fast environment computation) …
